title: Médicos Especialistas – Programa de Inteligência Clínica (MetaQare) - Brazil
description:
Médico Especialista – Programa de Inteligência Clínica (MetaQare) - Brazil

Empresa: MetaQare IntelliHealth

Local: Remoto – Brasil

Tipo de colaboração: Participação científica remunerada / contrato de autoria



Sobre a oportunidade

A MetaQare busca médicos especialistas interessados em participar do programa internacional Authors of Clinical AI (ACAI) — a primeira rede global onde médicos transformam sua experiência clínica em inteligência médica aplicada , criando um legado que transcende gerações.

O objetivo é integrar conhecimento clínico real à medicina digital, promovendo inovação, segurança e acesso universal ao saber médico.



Responsabilidades

  • Contribuir com sua experiência médica para a criação de um modelo clínico digital , baseado em raciocínio clínico e evidência científica.
  • Validar e revisar periodicamente o modelo com base em novas diretrizes médicas.
  • Colaborar com a equipe científica da MetaQare em projetos de pesquisa e inovação em saúde digital.
  • Atuar como autor clínico em uma plataforma internacional reconhecida.



Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Medicina e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM) .
  • Especialização reconhecida (Cardiologia, Oncologia, Dermatologia, Gastroenterologia, Neurologia, Endocrinologia, Pediatria, entre outras).
  • Experiência clínica mínima de 5 anos.
  • Interesse em tecnologia médica, inteligência artificial e inovação em saúde.
  • Disponibilidade para colaboração remota e revisão periódica de conteúdo.



O que a MetaQare oferece

  • Participação no primeiro programa internacional de inteligência médica criada por clínicos.
  • Apoio científico, ético e tecnológico completo para o desenvolvimento do seu modelo clínico.
  • Contrato de autoria com direito a royalties baseados no uso clínico real.
  • Visibilidade global por meio de metaqare.ai e do Global Medical Innovation Panel.
  • Oportunidade de liderar a transição para uma medicina aumentada por inteligência .

Mais informações: metaqare.ai/authors_of_clinical_ai.php



About MetaQare

For centuries, medicine has advanced through observation, experience, and human judgement.

Today, for the first time in history, we have the ability to amplify that clinical wisdom — beyond borders, beyond time, and beyond the limits of any single practitioner.

MetaQare was founded on a simple but powerful idea:

that the clinical wisdom of the world’s finest physicians should be accessible to every patient, everywhere.

This is not about replacing doctors —

it’s about enhancing their intelligence.

It’s about transforming clinical reasoning into a language that machines can understand, learn from, and scale — with ethics, precision, and transparency.

Every doctor who joins Authors of Clinical AI is not merely teaching an algorithm —

they are leaving their mark on the history of medicine.

For the first time, human knowledge becomes a living legacy ,

with a name, a signature, and a purpose.

MetaQare is not just building software —

it is building the collective intelligence of humanity in healthcare .

And we want you to be part of it.



Como participar

Os médicos selecionados farão parte do grupo inaugural de 100 especialistas que ajudarão a moldar o futuro da prática médica digital.

Inscrições abertas: metaqare.ai/authors_of_clinical_ai.php

Contato:



Seu conhecimento. Sua assinatura. Seu legado.

MetaQare marca o início de uma nova era —

a medicina, escrita por médicos.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $5,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $5,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Assegurar conformidade com acordos de licenciamento SAP, otimizando o uso de licenças e evitando custos desnecessários.
  • Implementar e gerenciar dashboards e processos que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real sobre a eficiência dos recursos de nuvem e custos associados.
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI e áreas de negócio para promover uma cultura de colaboração interfuncional e responsabilidade financeira.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em gestão de custos de nuvem e otimização de recursos (FinOps).
  • Conhecimento em SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Microsoft Power BI e Excel avançado.
  • Experiência com sistemas SAP ECC, S/4HANA e SAP HANA (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Matemática, Estatística, Física ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

title: .NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)
description:
.NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)


Remote (Brazil-based)

Candidates must be resident in Brazil and eligible to work remotely from within the country.


Salary:

$7,000-9,000 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.


Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced .NET Architect with deep expertise in AWS Cloud Services and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will lead the modernization of existing applications, architect scalable and cost-efficient solutions, and drive performance optimization through effective use of .NET Core and AWS tools .



Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design

  • Define, design, and implement cloud-native and hybrid architectures leveraging .NET Core and AWS services .
  • Lead modernization initiatives, re-platforming legacy .NET applications into scalable, containerized, or serverless solutions.
  • Establish and enforce coding, security, and performance standards aligned with best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize workloads on AWS , leveraging services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch , etc.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deliver robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar tools .
  • Drive cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability.

Performance & Monitoring

  • Implement comprehensive observability and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch .
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, ensuring low-latency, high-availability systems.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, consistent, and maintainable architecture.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in architectural decision-making and technology direction.


Key Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with advanced knowledge of .NET Framework and .NET Core, Web APIs , and microservices .
  • Proven experience architecting and deploying workloads on AWS .
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS ).

Cloud & DevOps

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , AWS CloudFormation , or AWS CDK .
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics and dashboards.
  • Deep understanding of performance tuning, logging, and distributed tracing in cloud environments.


Desirable Experience

  • Familiarity with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, SNS, SQS).
  • Knowledge of database performance tuning (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Experience with API security , OAuth2/JWT , and distributed caching (Redis, Elasticache).

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.

title: Business/Function Analysts
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Business/Function Analysts , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

The IT Business/Functional Analyst plays a critical role in bridging business needs with technological solutions. The primary function is to analyze and interpret business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure that technology solutions are aligned with the company's objectives. This role requires working closely with business users, developers, and project managers to deliver effective technology solutions that enhance business processes and improve efficiency.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Requirements Analysis and Specification: Conduct in-depth analysis of business requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications for the development team. Create wireframes and mockups to visualize the proposed solutions.
  • Solution Design and Testing: Collaborating with developers and system architects to design solutions that meet business needs. Develop and execute test plans and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Stakeholder Management and Leadership: Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Lead and coordinate project activities, ensuring that tasks are completed on time.
  • Risk Management and Budgeting: Identify and mitigate risks in technology projects. Assist in managing project budgets and ensure the use of resources in a cost-effective manner.
  • Documentation and Support: Create comprehensive user documentation and training materials. Provide ongoing technical support for implemented solutions.
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze and resolve system problems and incidents. Participate in change management to ensure smooth transitions and user adoption.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience as a business or functional analyst in an IT environment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Languages: Advanced English and/or French.



Tools and Abilities:

  • Proficiency in business analytics tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio .
  • Experience with project management software such as Jira, Trello, Microsoft Project, and Asana .
  • Knowledge in SQL and experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server and MySQL.
  • Familiarity with SDLC methodologies , including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall .
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP and CRM systems such as Salesforce .

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and lead project activities.
  • Leadership: Proven experience in project and team management, with the ability to mentor junior team members.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or related field.
  • Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified ScrumMaster .
  • Knowledge: Experience in specific industries such as finance, healthcare, or manufacturing. Advanced programming skills in languages such as Python, Java or C# .

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: .NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)
description:
.NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)


Remote (Brazil-based)

Candidates must be resident in Brazil and eligible to work remotely from within the country.


Salary:

$7,000-9,000 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.


Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced .NET Architect with deep expertise in AWS Cloud Services and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will lead the modernization of existing applications, architect scalable and cost-efficient solutions, and drive performance optimization through effective use of .NET Core and AWS tools .



Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design

  • Define, design, and implement cloud-native and hybrid architectures leveraging .NET Core and AWS services .
  • Lead modernization initiatives, re-platforming legacy .NET applications into scalable, containerized, or serverless solutions.
  • Establish and enforce coding, security, and performance standards aligned with best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize workloads on AWS , leveraging services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch , etc.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deliver robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar tools .
  • Drive cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability.

Performance & Monitoring

  • Implement comprehensive observability and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch .
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, ensuring low-latency, high-availability systems.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, consistent, and maintainable architecture.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in architectural decision-making and technology direction.


Key Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with advanced knowledge of .NET Framework and .NET Core, Web APIs , and microservices .
  • Proven experience architecting and deploying workloads on AWS .
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS ).

Cloud & DevOps

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , AWS CloudFormation , or AWS CDK .
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics and dashboards.

Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

About us

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.

  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;

  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, por meio de conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Apoio a criação do plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos, de forma suficiente à posterior compreensão da atividade executada;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.
  • Desenvolver os trabalhos de depuração e testes de programa, executando serviços de manutenção nos programas já existentes identificando as causas de erros e realizar as correções necessárias a fim de obter os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Receber a especificação funcional para desenvolvimento, melhoria e manutenção de softwares, avaliar e estimar o tempo necessário para execução de acordo com o previsto na proposta técnica;
  • Realizar testes básicos da codificação efetuada, de acordo com as instruções contidas na especificação, de forma a minimizar a propagação de erros para a fase de testes;
  • Entender e discutir a estratégia de codificação com o Especialista e/ou Analista da equipe e codificar a solução de software necessária para atender o recurso definido para o produto seguindo as diretrizes, políticas e estratégias da empresa;
  • Apoiar na realização de testes automatizados, unidade, integração, desempenho etc.
  • Aplicar procedimentos definidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento, com base nas especificações detalhadas das funcionalidades a serem criadas no projeto;
  • Transformar requisitos em um sistema pronto, bem como realizar as fases de elaboração de requisitos e da programação de sistemas; Conhecer tecnicamente as fases das atividades, identificar e orientar a solução de problemas;
  • Utilizar a ferramenta e os procedimentos estabelecidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento da empresa para reportar problemas encontrados, indicar o progresso das suas atividades, apontar horas trabalhadas e demais informações aplicáveis;
  • Contribuir na estimativa de novas funcionalidades e na avaliação do impacto de novos requisitos a projetos, com relação à complexidade e viabilidade do esforço da implementação desenvolvida.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de negócio com o objetivo de desenhar e desenvolver;
  • Entender, criar, manipular e consultar bancos de dados visando a execução das etapas de desenvolvimento do programa;
  • Corrigir e propor melhorias em bugs, bem como desenvolver novas funcionalidades para os sistemas propondo soluções/melhorias e realizar a implantação das funcionalidades em ambientes;
  • Definir soluções técnicas de acordo com a tecnologia utilizada nos projetos em desenvolvimento, através da produção de código limpo e eficiente;
  • Participar do sprint para elaboração do plano de trabalho e distribuição das atividades, bem como programar, implementar e manter rotinas;
  • Alinhar com o gestor a demanda, funcionalidades e aplicação nas operações de desenvolvimento;
  • Projetar e desenvolver APIs de integração capazes de lidar com alto volume de dados;
  • Buscar novas ferramentas e técnicas para a melhoria contínua de nossos sistemas;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação e compliance estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação :

  • Graduando ou Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software e desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e/ou microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react, Java, Sprint boot, SQL;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando as linguagens.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;

Nessa posição você irá:

O(A) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior é responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar os pipelines de dados que servem como base para as iniciativas de Business Intelligence e Ciência de Dados da empresa. Este profissional atuará como uma referência técnica, garantindo que as soluções de dados sejam escaláveis, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades de negócio. Sua missão é transformar dados brutos em insights acionáveis, trabalhando em ambientes de alto volume e criticidade para suportar decisões estratégicas em públicos heterogêneos.


Principais Responsabilidades

● Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos, utilizando ferramentas como Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines e SSIS.

● Modelar dados em formatos relacionais e multidimensionais (Star Schema) para otimizar consultas e análises.

● Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Ciência de Dados e Análise de Negócio, garantindo o acesso a dados de qualidade.

● Implementar e gerenciar soluções de Big Data em ambientes cloud, principalmente em Microsoft Azure (Data Lake, Synapse Analytics).

● Garantir a governança dos dados, aplicando padrões de desenvolvimento, qualidade e segurança.

● Automatizar processos de carga e replicação de dados, incluindo cenários de real-time.

● Colaborar na implementação de esteiras de DevOps (CI/CD) para projetos de Analytics e IA.


Formação e Experiência Mínima

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos atuando diretamente com Engenharia de Dados ou Business Intelligence.
  • Estabilidade profissional com média de 2 anos nas últimas experiências registradas no currículo.
  • Formação superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Não serão considerados cursos de curta duração ou predominantemente online.
  • Inglês em nível avançado para leitura técnica e comunicação.


Certificações

  • Obrigatório: Possuir pelo menos uma certificação técnica ativa relacionada à engenharia de dados.
  • Exemplo recomendado: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203).


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de dados heterogêneos, críticos e com alto volume.
  • Domínio de modelagem de dados multidimensional (star schema) e relacional.
  • SQL em nível avançado para consultas complexas e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente SSIS, Azure Synapse Pipelines ou Azure Data Factory.
  • Conhecimento em ecossistemas Big Data (ex: Hadoop) e programação em Python para manipulação de dados.
  • Vivência com soluções de BI e visualização, especialmente Power BI.
  • Experiência com a stack de dados da Microsoft Azure: Azure SQL DB, Synapse Analytics (anteriormente SQL DW), Data Lake Store, e noções de Azure Machine Learning


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo e engajado na resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de organização, foco e gestão de prioridades.
  • Atitude colaborativa para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares.


Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

description:

  • Experience in data engineering, architecture, or ETL development;
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala for data processing;
  • Advanced SQL expertise and proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server);

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering


Position Overview

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining our company’s core business applications. We’re seeking a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual should be equally comfortable working on both the front-end (React) and back-end (PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL) of modern web applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.


Strong English communication skills are essential for this role, as you’ll be working closely with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams. You should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts, document your work effectively, and participate in discussions and code reviews with confidence.


What You Will Do

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP and PostgreSQL .
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using React and modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enhance our company’s product line and ensure optimal system performance.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define technical direction for new features and system improvements.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in full stack development, contributing ideas for process and tool improvements.
  • Mentor, guide, and provide technical support to junior developers and team members.
  • Communicate effectively with non-technical teams and management to explain technical solutions in a clear, professional manner.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation to ensure knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability of code.


What You Will Bring

  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested code (samples may be requested).
  • Strong understanding of PHP , PostgreSQL , and SQL , with hands-on experience in designing, optimizing, and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or other modern front-end frameworks for building scalable, interactive web interfaces.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality, reliable software.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills , with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working in agile, team-based environments .
  • Experience in the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • Enjoys documenting code and processes, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving both personal and team skills.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, and globally distributed environment .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development, including both back-end and front-end technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects from conception to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) principles and agile methodologies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

A BU de Banking PJ é especializada em oferecer soluções financeiras customizadas. O profissional ideal terá experiência “hands-on” com arquitetura de sistemas, desenvolvimento backend e habilidades para liderar iniciativas técnicas complexas. Seu desafio será atuar como referência técnica em múltiplos times, ajudando a definir a arquitetura, padrões e melhores práticas para garantir a escalabilidade, performance e segurança das soluções digitais.

  • Garantir que as soluções técnicas estejam em conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos pela empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Sólida experiência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e desenvolvimento, utilizando linguagens como PHP, Laravel, Lumem, HyperF .
  • Expertise em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka), orquestração de containers (Kubernetes, Docker) e arquiteturas baseadas em microserviços.
  • Conhecimento de práticas de CI/CD, automação de testes e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Vivência em ambientes de grande escala e alta demanda, com foco em otimização de performance e escalabilidade.

  • Forte capacidade de comunicação e influência, com habilidade para colaborar com múltiplas equipes e stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de balancear a visão estratégica com a execução técnica, tomando decisões que gerem impacto no longo prazo.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

Ser a pessoa responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações acessíveis e confiáveis, conectando a área técnica às necessidades de negócio e garantindo que as soluções construídas sustentem a tomada de decisão estratégica da empresa.

  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas e comunicá-las ao time de dados;
  • Elaborar desenhos de solução e propor melhorias;

  • Elaborar PoCs (Provas de Conceito) para validação de soluções;
  • Otimizar processos de ETL;
  • Disseminar melhores práticas de uso e governança de dados;
  • Contribuir em projetos de migração e integração de dados;
  • Participar de discussões baseadas em dados, apoiando decisões estratégicas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft Azure (Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Cosmos DB, SQL Database, Data Lake Storage)
  • Vivência em criação de desenhos de solução e modelagem de dados (relacionais e não relacionais);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados, aplicando políticas e processos eficazes;
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação técnica e arquitetural;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho colaborativo com diferentes áreas;
  • Interesse contínuo em aprender e se atualizar em novas tecnologias;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integrações de dados complexas;
  • Experiência com Big Data, utilizando ferramentas como Jupyter Notebook, Hadoop, R, Python e MapReduce.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Atuar na definição e implementação de arquiteturas de dados, tanto em Cloud quanto On-Premises;
  • Construir e manter estruturas de Data Lake e Data Warehouse;
  • Liderar tecnicamente times ou iniciativas de engenharia de dados;
  • Implementar boas práticas de governança e segurança da informação;
  • Possuir certificações Microsoft relevantes para a área (como Azure Data Engineer ou Azure Solutions Architect).

Básico que a gente ama

  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)

  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

  • Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

description:
Job description

About Us:


We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Mobile App Developer who can independently develop custom mobile applications using React Native , based on provided Figma designs. You will be working on a full-stack mobile app , where data is imported from an ASP.Net desktop application using Microsoft Azure and MongoDB .



Role Overview:


As a Senior Mobile App Developer , you will be responsible for building high-quality, custom mobile applications from the ground up using React Native. You’ll collaborate closely with our design and backend teams, bringing UI/UX to life with precision. This role requires a self-driven developer with strong attention to detail , 8+ years of experience , and a proven track record of delivering pixel-perfect, functional mobile apps independently.



Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop fully functional and high-performance React Native mobile applications based on Figma designs .
  • Build custom features and functionalities that enhance the user experience and meet complex business needs.
  • Integrate data from an ASP.Net backend system using Azure and MongoDB .
  • Ensure pixel-perfect implementation , responsiveness, and performance across different devices.
  • Independently manage the entire development lifecycle , including coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Collaborate with the design team and backend developers to ensure seamless integration of front-end and back-end functionalities.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize mobile applications to improve performance and reliability.
  • Follow best practices in mobile development, code quality, and version control using Git .
  • Stay current with the latest trends, libraries, and best practices in mobile app development .


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to build and launch apps independently , with a portfolio showcasing solo projects.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern mobile development tools.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with ASP.Net , Azure , and MongoDB .
  • Deep understanding of mobile app architecture , design patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Strong ability to translate Figma designs into responsive and accurate UI components.
  • Experience working in agile environments and using tools like Git and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Excellent problem-solving , time management , and communication skills.

description:
Título do cargo: SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)


Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: Disponibilidade para trabalhar em qualquer fuso horário da América Latina (México ou Brasil).


Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais.
