title: Especialista em segurança
description:
A Stone está com uma oportunidade em seu time de Segurança em Desenvolvimento (AppSec) na área de Segurança da Informação para trabalhar com foco em projetos de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais! Você gosta de buscar novos desafios e adquirir novos conhecimentos para acelerar o desenvolvimento de carreira? Se sim, venha fazer parte do nosso time de Segurança da Informação, como Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior na Stone!

O time de AppSec tem como propósito garantir que os aplicativos sejam desenvolvidos, mantidos e utilizados de maneira segura e protegida contra ameaças cibernéticas. Buscamos evitar que nossos sistemas tenham vulnerabilidades que possam ser exploradas por criminosos cibernéticos, visando proteger dados sensíveis, a privacidade dos usuários e a integridade das aplicações.


Como é ser Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior?


Dentre as atividades de trabalho esperadas, estão:


Estratégia, Colaboração e Arquitetura Segura em IA:

  • Ser o ponto focal de segurança, colaborando diretamente com times de engenharia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Participar e conduzir ativamente revisões de arquitetura para sistemas baseados em IA, desde a concepção até a fase de produção.
  • Realizar threat modeling específico para identificar e mitigar vetores de ataque exclusivos de sistemas de IA.
  • Desenvolver e manter um programa de segurança, abrangendo atividades defensivas e ofensivas, para aplicações de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI).

Domínio de Riscos e Vulnerabilidades de Segurança em IA:

  • Possuir profundo conhecimento em riscos de segurança e privacidade específicos de IA, incluindo (mas não limitado a) o OWASP Top 10 for LLMs :
  • Prompt Injection e técnicas de jailbreak.
  • Insecure Output Handling e riscos de execução de código.
  • Data Poisoning em datasets de treino/fine-tuning.
  • Model Denial of Service e ataques de exaustão de recursos.
  • Vulnerabilidades na cadeia de suprimentos (Supply Chain) de modelos, dados e dependências.
  • Vazamento de Informações Sensíveis (Sensitive Information Disclosure).
  • Insecure Plugin Design e riscos associados a tool/function calling.
  • Excessive Agency em sistemas e agentes autônomos.
  • Ataques de Inversão de Modelo e Inferência de Membro (Model Inversion/Membership Inference Attacks).
  • Roubo de Modelo (Model Theft).

Segurança em Arquiteturas e Componentes Específicos de IA:

  • Avaliação de Pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): Foco em segurança de Vector databases, embeddings, estratégias de chunking e manipulação/injeção de contexto.
  • Revisão de Sistemas de Agentes Autônomos: Análise de limites de execução de tools/functions, segurança de memória/contexto persistente do agente e transparência de raciocínio (chain-of-thought).
  • Protocolos e Integrações: Avaliar a segurança do Model Context Protocol (MCP) e integrações.
  • Fluxos de Fine-tuning: Analisar workflows de fine-tuning e riscos de injeção de backdoors.
  • Controles de Segurança: Validar a implementação de guardrails e sistemas de filtragem de conteúdo (content filtering).

Governança, Compliance e Maturidade em IA:

  • Aplicar frameworks de avaliação de maturidade em segurança de IA (ex: OWASP AI Maturity Assessment).
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações emergentes (ex: AI Act, Executive Orders) e suas implicações técnicas.
  • Implementar controles de privacidade diferencial e minimização de dados.
  • Estabelecer políticas de governança de modelos e versionamento seguro.

Capacidades Técnicas e Operacionais:

  • Ciclo de Vida de LLMs: Conhecimento aprofundado em pre-training, fine-tuning, RLHF, alignment, padrões de deployment (API-based, on-premise, edge) e implicações de segurança do prompt engineering.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar a detecção de model drift, bias drift, concept drift e métricas de segurança (ex: toxicity scores, jailbreak attempts, PII leakage). Realizar anomaly detection e auditoria de prompts e outputs.
  • Infraestrutura de IA em Cloud: Experiência com serviços gerenciados de LLM (ex: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI), segurança de containers para workloads de ML/AI, gerenciamento de segredos (secrets management) e isolamento de rede.

Testes e Validação de Segurança:

  • Conduzir security assessments de aplicações baseadas em LLM utilizando metodologias específicas.
  • Realizar exercícios simulando ataques como prompt injection, jailbreak, cenários de exfiltração de dados e adversarial inputs.
  • Validar controles de rate limiting, prevenção de abuso e gerenciamento de custos.
  • Testar sandboxing e isolamento para execução de código.


Outras Contribuições e Habilidades:

  • Avaliar riscos e definir requisitos e padrões de segurança.
  • Realizar revisões de código e design de arquitetura.
  • Implementar testes de segurança automatizados e auxiliar na mitigação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Promover o treinamento e a sensibilização dos times de desenvolvimento.
  • Integrar segurança de forma eficiente nos processos de desenvolvimento (shift-left).
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências de segurança em IA.
  • Utilizar a experiência e intuição de segurança para buscar ameaças nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.
  • Ter iniciativa para buscar ou solicitar dados importantes que estejam ausentes.
  • Desenvolver soluções criativas e complexas que equilibrem riscos e necessidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade plena de leitura e comunicação eficiente em inglês.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhorias, novas soluções e alertas que possam beneficiar e/ou facilitar a operação
  • Usar habilidades de influência e negociação para direcionar os times a corrigirem problemas ou a utilizar arquiteturas adequadas do ponto de vista de segurança
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia
  • Interesse e dedicação em aprender e se adaptar a cenários que utilizam novas tecnologias com as quais ainda não teve contato e que entreguem mais segurança aos produtos
  • Comunicar-se de forma concisa, franca e assertiva, sabendo traduzir problemas complexos para uma linguagem acessível ao público com o qual se comunica
  • Possuir curso Superior (concluído ou em andamento) em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Inteligência Artificial ou cursos relacionados
  • Paixão por aprender e prosperar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança
  • Conhecimento de vetores de ataque comuns
  • Conhecimento dos serviços básicos e conceitos de segurança de Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Experiência com monitoramento de segurança, análise de logs e ferramentas forenses
  • Facilidade de trabalhar dentro de times multi-disciplinares com metodologia ágil



O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Desenvolvimento de software: conhecimentos que permitam criar códigos para funcionalidades e integrações pontuais, em especial Python
  • Experiência e conhecimento em tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais usando LLM (Large Language Model)
  • Experiência com gestão de incidentes, vulnerabilidade, riscos,etc
  • Experiência com guidelines e ferramentas OWASP

Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: Especialista em Segurança da Informação e Cibernética
description:

-Monitoramento dos serviços de rede, conectividade, firewall, SSE (Security Service Edge), EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), WAF (Web Application Firewall), computação em nuvem e Gestão de Vulnerabilidades;

-Ensino Superior completo ou Pós-graduação completa na área de TI

de Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) de mercado; e/ou

de Endpoint detection and response (EDR) de mercado; e/ou

de Web Application Firewall (WAF) de mercado; e/ou

de Gestão de Vulnerabilidade de mercado

Palo Alto Networks Certified Security Automation Engineer

(PCSAE); ou

Analyst (PCDRA); ou

title: Product Manager
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Product Manager Especialista em Cobrança

Principais atividades

Gestão de produtos financeiros estratégicos, com foco em meios de pagamentos.

Responsável por criar e manter o roadmap dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamento, alinhando-o com a estratégia da empresa e com as necessidades do mercado.

Gerir o ciclo de vida do produto, atuando em todas as fases: concepção, desenvolvimento, lançamento, crescimento, maturidade e encerramento.

Apoiar a definição de pricing, go-to-market e posicionamento dos produtos, em parceria com as áreas de marketing e comercial.

Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo a entrega de valor para os cooperados por meio da estruturação de histórias de usuário e épicos bem definidos.

Responsável em conduzir o Discovery de produto, analisando a causa raiz das dores dos usuários, levantando hipóteses e validando ideias para garantir que as soluções sejam aderentes às necessidades dos cooperados, direcionando o desenvolvimento do produto para o resultado desejado e ajudando a remover os obstáculos que possam impedir a entrega esperada.

Liderar times ágeis, garantindo entregas eficientes e alinhadas às expectativas dos cooperados.

Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto e análise de dados para tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

Monitorar tendências do mercado financeiro, regulatórias e tecnológicas para manter os produtos competitivos.

Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do BACEN e demais órgãos reguladores.

Atuar na integração de APIs e novos parceiros para ampliar a oferta de serviços.

Realizar benchmarking, acompanhando tendências de mercado e a concorrência para propor a criação e melhorias.

Responsável por liderar times multidisciplinares, como no entendimento das dificuldades, definição das estratégias e valor entregue dos produtos e priorização.

Responsável por fazer a ponte entre negócios, tecnologia e design. buscando o equilíbrio para o desenvolvimento de produtos digitais.

Garantir que o Backlog do Produto seja visível, transparente e claro para todos.

Participar de homologações, validando as soluções implementadas e garantindo a entrega de valor esperada.

Organização e priorização de tarefas: Capacidade de levantar e detalhar requisitos, incluindo especificações funcionais para desenvolvimento.


Requisitos desejados

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis: Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto/projetos: Jira, Miro, Confluence.

Elaboração e gestão de backlog: saber escrever histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite, priorizar com base em valor de negócio.

Conhecimento em tecnologia: Familiaridade com integrações bancárias, gateways e APIs.

Análise de dados e métricas de produto: Habilidade analítica para interpretar métricas, identificar oportunidades e direcionar melhorias nos produtos digitais (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude, Power BI etc.)

Conhecimento em produtos financeiros: especialmente relacionados gestão dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamentos (TED/DOC, boletos, carteiras digitais, adquirência, recorrência, split de pagamentos, convênios).

Experiência com frameworks de priorização: Conhecimento em frameworks como RICE, MoSCoW, Value vs. Effort, Kano, entre outros, para auxiliar na priorização de iniciativas.

Conhecimento em Product Discovery: Domínio das etapas de discovery contínuo, entrevistas com usuários, mapeamento de jornada, análise de concorrência e prototipação rápida.


Diferenciais

Experiência como Product Manager ou posição similar em instituições financeiras ou de pagamentos como fintechs, bancos ou cooperativas.

Formação em áreas como Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Marketing ou afins.

Pós-graduação ou MBA com ênfase em Inovação ou Tecnologia, Produto e Gestão Ágil, Negócios e Estratégia ou áreas afins.


Certificações desejáveis:

- CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner)

- PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner)

- Tera, PM3.

- SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework)

- ICP-APO (ICAgile Certified Professional – Agile Product Ownership)


Conhecimento sobre regulamentação do Banco Central.

title: Product Manager
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Product Manager Especialista em Cobrança

Principais atividades

Gestão de produtos financeiros estratégicos, com foco em meios de pagamentos.

Responsável por criar e manter o roadmap dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamento, alinhando-o com a estratégia da empresa e com as necessidades do mercado.

Gerir o ciclo de vida do produto, atuando em todas as fases: concepção, desenvolvimento, lançamento, crescimento, maturidade e encerramento.

Apoiar a definição de pricing, go-to-market e posicionamento dos produtos, em parceria com as áreas de marketing e comercial.

Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo a entrega de valor para os cooperados por meio da estruturação de histórias de usuário e épicos bem definidos.

Responsável em conduzir o Discovery de produto, analisando a causa raiz das dores dos usuários, levantando hipóteses e validando ideias para garantir que as soluções sejam aderentes às necessidades dos cooperados, direcionando o desenvolvimento do produto para o resultado desejado e ajudando a remover os obstáculos que possam impedir a entrega esperada.

Liderar times ágeis, garantindo entregas eficientes e alinhadas às expectativas dos cooperados.

Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto e análise de dados para tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

Monitorar tendências do mercado financeiro, regulatórias e tecnológicas para manter os produtos competitivos.

Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do BACEN e demais órgãos reguladores.

Atuar na integração de APIs e novos parceiros para ampliar a oferta de serviços.

Realizar benchmarking, acompanhando tendências de mercado e a concorrência para propor a criação e melhorias.

Responsável por liderar times multidisciplinares, como no entendimento das dificuldades, definição das estratégias e valor entregue dos produtos e priorização.

Responsável por fazer a ponte entre negócios, tecnologia e design. buscando o equilíbrio para o desenvolvimento de produtos digitais.

Garantir que o Backlog do Produto seja visível, transparente e claro para todos.

Participar de homologações, validando as soluções implementadas e garantindo a entrega de valor esperada.

Organização e priorização de tarefas: Capacidade de levantar e detalhar requisitos, incluindo especificações funcionais para desenvolvimento.


Requisitos desejados

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis: Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto/projetos: Jira, Miro, Confluence.

Elaboração e gestão de backlog: saber escrever histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite, priorizar com base em valor de negócio.

Conhecimento em tecnologia: Familiaridade com integrações bancárias, gateways e APIs.

Análise de dados e métricas de produto: Habilidade analítica para interpretar métricas, identificar oportunidades e direcionar melhorias nos produtos digitais (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude, Power BI etc.)

Conhecimento em produtos financeiros: especialmente relacionados gestão dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamentos (TED/DOC, boletos, carteiras digitais, adquirência, recorrência, split de pagamentos, convênios).

Experiência com frameworks de priorização: Conhecimento em frameworks como RICE, MoSCoW, Value vs. Effort, Kano, entre outros, para auxiliar na priorização de iniciativas.

Conhecimento em Product Discovery: Domínio das etapas de discovery contínuo, entrevistas com usuários, mapeamento de jornada, análise de concorrência e prototipação rápida.


Diferenciais

Experiência como Product Manager ou posição similar em instituições financeiras ou de pagamentos como fintechs, bancos ou cooperativas.

Formação em áreas como Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Marketing ou afins.

Pós-graduação ou MBA com ênfase em Inovação ou Tecnologia, Produto e Gestão Ágil, Negócios e Estratégia ou áreas afins.


Certificações desejáveis:

- CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner)

- PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner)

- Tera, PM3.

- SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework)

- ICP-APO (ICAgile Certified Professional – Agile Product Ownership)


Conhecimento sobre regulamentação do Banco Central.

description:

Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 09h00 às 18h00 ou das 10h00 às 19h00.



Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.



Objetivo do Cargo:


O(A) Gerente de CRM e Personalização em Escala atua como o elo estratégico entre a visão de engajamento do consumidor e a execução impecável das campanhas . Como líder funcional no design de jornadas e segmentação de audiência, esse profissional é responsável por transformar insights de consumidores e objetivos de negócio em estratégias avançadas de CRM e Fidelidade , abrangendo múltiplos canais e mercados.

Esse cargo define estruturas de comunicação por ciclo de vida , táticas de personalização e lógicas de segmentação que impulsionam a ativação significativa de dados primários (1P data). Inclui também orientar a priorização de jornadas, garantir consistência entre marcas e plataformas e incorporar ciclos de aprendizado contínuos para otimizar o desempenho.

Embora não execute diretamente nas plataformas, o cargo é o proprietário do modelo funcional (blueprint) — garantindo que as campanhas sejam relevantes para o consumidor, orientadas por dados, tecnicamente viáveis e alinhadas aos objetivos comerciais . Além disso, facilita o alinhamento com as equipes de conteúdo, marketing e implantação , conectando todos os insumos necessários para criar jornadas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto nos resultados de negócio .


Principais Responsabilidades:


1) Marketing Direto e Ativação de Audiências

  • Liderar o design e a documentação das jornadas completas de CRM ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do cliente (ex.: aquisição, onboarding, reativação, fidelização), garantindo alinhamento estratégico e viabilidade técnica .
  • Traduzir insights de consumidores e prioridades de marca em lógicas de jornada , definindo gatilhos, tempos de espera, ramificações e metas .
  • Definir e evoluir o roadmap de CRM e Personalização entre marcas e mercados, em linha com as prioridades do setor.
  • Fornecer orientação estratégica às equipes de operação e técnica sobre configuração de jornadas, uso de conteúdo dinâmico e orquestração de mensagens.
  • Ser o responsável funcional pelo (Personalization at Scale) , incorporando sinais comportamentais e contextuais às ativações de CRM.

2) Dados, Mensuração e Otimização

  • Colaborar com as equipes de dados para aproveitar modelos preditivos, sinais comportamentais e oportunidades de enriquecimento de dados primários (1PD) .
  • Definir KPIs e métricas de sucesso para programas de CRM, incluindo engajamento, conversão e incremento de receita.
  • Integrar insights de performance em novas iterações estratégicas, identificando oportunidades de teste e aprendizado e lacunas de desempenho .
  • Trabalhar em parceria com líderes de CDP/CDNA para aprimorar a lógica de segmentação e as táticas de personalização orientadas por dados.

3) Alinhamento Multifuncional e Suporte a Stakeholders

  • Atuar como elo estratégico de CRM para as equipes de marca e mercados locais, aconselhando sobre viabilidade e melhores práticas .
  • Guiar a priorização de jornadas e segmentos de consumidores com base em impacto de negócio, nível de personalização e oportunidade de audiência.


Experiência e Competências Necessárias:


  • 5 a 7 anos de experiência em funções estratégicas de CRM ou Marketing Direto, com expertise comprovada em marketing de ciclo de vida e personalização em escala .
  • Domínio em personalização orientada por dados , design de jornadas complexas e lógica de segmentação .
  • Conhecimento funcional do Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extensions e Triggers), suficiente para orientar equipes de execução.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura CDP/CDNA , lógica de ativação e fluxos de integração de audiências.
  • Familiaridade com mecânicas de fidelidade, jornadas de indicação, estratégias de gamificação e modelos de engajamento similares.
  • Perfil analítico , capaz de interpretar resultados de campanhas e traduzir insights em ajustes estratégicos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e capacidade de sintetizar informações de marca, dados, tecnologia e times globais em estratégias de CRM acionáveis .
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em organizações grandes e matriciais , com ecossistemas de CRM de alto volume.
  • Vivência em CPG (bens de consumo), varejo ou modelos baseados em assinatura .
  • Familiaridade com integrações CRM/adtech (ex.: uso combinado de dados pagos e proprietários para segmentação).
  • Histórico comprovado de melhoria de performance de CRM por meio de comunicações personalizadas e otimização de estratégias.
  • Experiência colaborando no desenvolvimento de templates de jornada , lógicas de decisão e playbooks de personalização .
  • Conhecimento em lógica de UX/CX ou frameworks de comunicação centrados no usuário (não voltados ao design visual).


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

Nossos Valores

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
O Grupo SCTODODIA é um dos principais grupos de comunicação de Santa Catarina, conectando o público às notícias e ao entretenimento através de nossas plataformas consolidadas: rádio, portal de notícias e redes sociais. Estamos em expansão e buscando um novo talento para integrar nossa força de vendas.


Missão do cargo:


Buscamos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por vendas e comunicação para atuar como Consultor(a) Comercial. O objetivo é expandir nossa base de anunciantes, oferecendo soluções de publicidade integradas (cross-media) que ajudem nossos clientes a alcançar resultados reais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Prospecção ativa: identificar, qualificar e prospectar (através de cold calls, e-mails, networking e visitas) novas oportunidades de negócios e potenciais anunciantes.
  • Gestão de carteira: gerenciar e rentabilizar a carteira de clientes existente, construindo relacionamentos sólidos e identificando oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Consultoria de mídia: entender profundamente as necessidades do cliente e desenvolver propostas comerciais personalizadas, combinando nossas soluções de rádio, portal de notícias e redes sociais.
  • Negociação e fechamento: conduzir todo o ciclo de venda, desde a apresentação da proposta até a negociação e o fechamento do contrato.
  • Pós-venda: acompanhar a entrega e os resultados das campanhas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência comprovada na área comercial, preferencialmente com vendas de publicidade, mídia (on ou offline), serviços ou em agências.
  • Domínio de técnicas de prospecção ativa e habilidade para abrir novas portas.
  • Sólida experiência em gestão de carteira de cliente , focando em relacionamento e fidelização.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e persuasão.
  • Foco em metas, organização e orientação para resultados.


Diferenciais (o que brilha aos nossos olhos):


  • Proatividade: ser alguém que não espera as coisas acontecerem e busca ativamente as soluções.
  • Colaboração em equipe: ter facilidade para trabalhar em conjunto, compartilhar ideias e contribuir para o sucesso do time.
  • Conhecimento do mercado de mídia digital (redes sociais, mídia programática).
  • Possuir veículo próprio (se aplicável para visitas).


Como se candidatar:


Se você é movido(a) a desafios, adora vender e quer crescer junto com um grupo de comunicação de referência, essa vaga é para você!


Envie seu currículo atualizado para:


Por favor, inclua "VAGA CONSULTOR DE VENDAS" no assunto do e-mail.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

title: Project Integration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Project Integration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

The Project Integration Specialist is responsible for overseeing the integration and coordination of various IT projects within the organization, ensuring that all components of the projects are aligned, executed efficiently, and meet the company's strategic objectives. This professional acts as a technical leader, advisor and mentor, ensuring the cohesion and success of integration projects.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Leadership and Technical Consulting: Acting as a technical lead to ensure that project implementations are aligned with architectural design, guiding cross-functional teams, and fostering communication and collaboration among all stakeholders.
  • End-to-End Solution Design: Develop and implement comprehensive integration plans for IT projects. Assess the compatibility and interoperability of different systems and technologies through thorough testing and evaluation.
  • Project and Resource Management: Plan and manage the timelines and deliverables of integration projects. Allocate and manage resources effectively, including budgeting and staffing. Monitor project progress and performance, ensuring adherence to timelines and budget.
  • Technology Selection and Validation: Conduct technical assessments and feasibility studies for new integration projects to determine the best approach and resources needed. Stay up-to-date on emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Risk Management: Identify and resolve integration issues and technical challenges through troubleshooting and collaboration with technical teams. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure projects stay on track.
  • Governance and Compliance: Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices throughout the integration process.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including integration plans, status reports, and risk assessments. Drive continuous improvement in integration processes and methodologies by analyzing project results and implementing feedback.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT project management , integration, or related field.
  • Systems Integration: Experience with a variety of integration tools and platforms (e.g., middleware, APIs) to facilitate the integration of projects, configuring and maintaining them. Experience in designing integrations between data systems and other enterprise platforms (e.g., ERPs such as SAP, CRMs).
  • Architecture: Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and software development. Experience with software architecture design, including microservices, SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture), and cloud-based architectures.
  • Systems and Tools: Use of integration tools and platforms. Implementation and management of systems to track and report metrics of integration projects, including the configuration of dashboards and monitoring tools.

Languages: Advanced English and/or French.


Soft Skills:

  • Communication and Influence: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to varied audiences (technical, executive, business). Build strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure their needs are met and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Ability to lead by example, working with cross-functional teams and building consensus among stakeholders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to think "in the big picture", aligning technological decisions with the company's long-term objectives.
  • Problem Solving: Proactive and analytical profile, engaged in identifying and solving complex challenges.

Organization and Focus: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and results-focused environment.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or other relevant certifications. Certifications in cloud architecture (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  • Technologies: Experience with cloud computing and data integration. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Expected Skills:

  • Ensure that the needs of the business are aligned with the architectural vision.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ensure scalability/performance, security, and quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in development processes and existing architecture.
  • Analyze the technological environment and seek possibilities for improvement and standardization in line with strategic planning.
  • Present to stakeholders how the architecture options will meet their needs.

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.


In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.


Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.
  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.


Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

Python. Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.

  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.

Good to Have

title: Marketing Coordinator

  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work

Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.

  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.



The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Engenheiro de Dados | Node.js • Scala • Databricks
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional , em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados .

Buscamos um profissional com foco em Engenharia de Dados , que possua background em desenvolvimento backend , especialmente com Node.js, Scala e Databricks , para atuar em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto tecnológico.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em Scala, preferencialmente e Databricks.
  • Experiência prática em Node.js, com foco em microserviços e APIs REST.
  • Vivência em engenharia de dados, especialmente com stream processing e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimentos em Azure (Data Lake, Databricks, Functions, Containers).
  • Experiência com Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Familiaridade com Docker, Git/GitLab, CI/CD e boas práticas de versionamento.
  • Domínio de DDD, TDD e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Perfil colaborativo, analítico e foco em resultados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em projetos de engenharia de dados e integração de grandes volumes de informação.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados em Scala e Databricks
  • Criar e evoluir serviços backend e APIs em Node.js, integrando-os a fluxos de dados e aplicações financeiras.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelos de dados em bancos relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server).
  • Implementar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados utilizando Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Automatizar e gerenciar pipelines CI/CD, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (Azure), configurando recursos e monitorando performance.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de engenharia, produto e dados para garantir escalabilidade, segurança e performance das soluções.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

CLT

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.

  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

Within 3 Months:

  • feedback loops

  • strategies

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved

  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up

title: Business Development Manager Sustainability
description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.


Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.
